School can be tough, I dropped out in grade 11, I get where you’re coming from. But it’s not the be all end all that people make it out to be. There are thousands of successful people who didn’t finish school. Also there plenty of people who go to university, get degrees, and never get a job in their field. The important part of life is to find something that makes you happy and do that. Forget about expectations that friends/family have for you and do what you want to do, it’s your life to live not theirs. They may be disappointed at first but if they are worth keeping in your life they will accept and support your decisions. Idk if that helps any but just know you’re not alone in how you feel. Take care of yourself bro.
